feeds.title: Coopers Corner
feeds.description: Coopers Corner is a budgie blog. The author shares his views on birds, bird movies, and more.

feeds.title: Hennie's Budgies Blog
feeds.description: I'm Hennie from Van Vuuren Aviaries. I've had show budgies for over 25 years. I'm a champion exhibitor. This blog is to help teach people about the proper care and handling of show budgies - and to raise awareness of the hobby.

feeds.title: The Budgie Academy Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Amy Zhao is an animal scientist living in Boston with her small flock of budgies and Gandalf the cockatiel. She has worked with and taken classes in management and husbandry for many animal species including sheep, cattle, horses, birds of prey, and course, parrots. She uses her experience and knowledge to help guide other budgie owners on their journey to care for their pet budgies.

feeds.title: Omlet Blog » Budgies
feeds.description: Learn everything you need to know about these amazing little birds! The Omlet blog is packed with high-quality, fun information for all. Omlet reimagines the way you live with and look after your pets to bring you closer together. By designing all of our products to be quick and easy to clean we create homes your pets will love living in and you'll love using.

feeds.title: All About Budgies
feeds.description: Our mission is to become a major source of knowledge for budgie pet owners. We strive to provide the most accurate and detailed information that we have personally collected over the years. Our site features product reviews, care guides, and recommendations for your budgies. We have been keeping, breeding, and caring for budgies for over 20 years. Our fascination began with two little Australian budgies that were purchased at a local swap meet in Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Haith's Blog
feeds.description: Cage & Aviary is a blog cum guide to becoming a budgie breeder, one will find articles that will help one become an expert on budgies. Haith's work on seed cleaning, blending, and packing to the highest standards available to ensure our customers receive the Quality, Cleanliness, and Service that insisted upon all those years ago.

feeds.title: Parakeet Pro Blog
feeds.description: Parakeet advise by people who know budgerigars. The blog is about budgerigars and budgies. Bird health, illness (sick birds), raising by hand, feeding, and general care.

feeds.title: Alen AxP Budgie Community
feeds.description: We are BudgieNation bringing you all you need to know when it comes to proper Budgie or Parakeet care! My name is Alen as known as Alen AxP and I have years of experience raising and keeping Budgerigars/Parakeets and have put together my knowledge to share with you. I have a lot of information and recommendations on the care of Budgies, including food, housing - cages, training to talk, play games, and more.

feeds.title: Homekeethome
feeds.description: This blog is intended to be a resource for both the novice and experienced parakeet owner or just a good story for anyone who likes reading about budgies. There are reviews of bird-related products as well as tips and tricks and fun stories about our many mistakes along the way.
